faqs.question: Do trainees need their own laptops from day one?

collegeEvents.title: HI-TECH Innovation & Applied AI Symposium 2026
collegeEvents.shortDescription: Flagship technology summit uniting industry engineers, AI researchers, TVET leaders, and students to explore practical automation, software engineering, and enterprise AI systems across East Africa.
collegeEvents.fullDescription:
The HI-TECH Innovation & Applied AI Symposium brings together software architects, data scientists, government skills regulators, and HI-TECH College trainees for a full day of live technical demonstrations, research panels, and hands-on AI deployment clinics.

Participants will examine real-world Kenyan case studies in smart agribusiness, fintech infrastructure security, computer vision for manufacturing, and TVET digital curriculum modernization. Students presenting capstone prototypes will showcase projects directly to hiring industry partners.

secureExamDefinitions.title: Computer Networking CAT
secureExamDefinitions.subject: ICT 204 · Computer Networking & Routing
instructions: Ensure a stable internet connection before launching Secure Examination Mode.
Do not switch browser tabs, exit fullscreen, or open external resources while the session is active.
All objective and structured answers autosave automatically and submit on expiry.
Contact the examination supervisor immediately if your device experiences a hardware or power fault.

questions.instruction: Provide concise, numbered points with technical terminology.
questions.text: Explain three core functions of a router in a computer network.
At which layer of the OSI reference model does a standard IP router primarily forward packets?

questions.instruction: Select all protocols that operate cleanly over TCP.
questions.text: Which of the following application-layer protocols rely on TCP for reliable transport?
A /26 IPv4 subnet mask provides 62 usable host addresses per subnet.
State the command used on Cisco IOS routers to verify the active routing table and explain two columns shown.

secureExamDefinitions.title: CSC 301 Data Structures & Algorithms CBT
secureExamDefinitions.subject: CSC 301 · Advanced Data Structures & Algorithms
instructions: Complete all questions within the 45-minute countdown.
Copy, paste, right-click, and developer tools shortcuts are blocked during the exam.
Your server-authoritative timer continues running even if the browser refreshes.

questions.text: Which data structure supports O(1) amortized insertion and LIFO retrieval?
Breadth-First Search (BFS) guarantees the shortest path in an unweighted graph.
Compare the worst-case time complexity of Merge Sort and QuickSort and identify when Merge Sort is preferred.
